spec2def(dpnlobby.dll dpnlobby.spec)

# dpnlobby.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dpnlobby-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(dpnlobby dpnlobby-cargo dpnlobby.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
